tagline: A threshold fix, a clearer connection and a sharper interface.

entries.headline: Stat thresholds now follow shared templates, the plugin connects to the relay outside a party, and the interface is sharper.

sections.title: Dice and templates
items: Fixed the "Threshold" mode: an imported or subscribed template now keeps its stat resolution, die direction, criticals and labels.
Templates that were already shared must be republished by their author to carry these settings.
Roll tiles: name, abbreviation and modifier are now separate, and the last column no longer slides under the scrollbar.

sections.title: Connection
items: The plugin connects to the relay as soon as the character loads, without waiting for a party or a lobby.
Four readable states: offline, reconnecting, connected to the server, and in session.
Leaving a party keeps the server connection instead of dropping it.

sections.title: Interface
items: Sharp title icons in every tab and in the settings.
Reworked empty states for markers and turn tracking, with a direct action.
Templates tab reorganized: aligned actions, tooltips, and an "Active" badge on the loaded template.
